name: V8 TrustedRange: 1GiB reservation that must be 4GiB aligned and must not lie in the first 4GiB of address space
required_postconditions: returned_base >= 4294967296 - the range must NOT be inside the first 4GiB, which is the region a sandbox escape can reach. V8 gets this by requiring 4GiB alignment and assuming the zeroth page can never be mapped, so the only 4GiB-aligned base below 2^32 is 0 and is unreachable
no address in the range has its upper 32 bits clear, or V8's stack-spill-slot scanner would mistake a trusted pointer for a compressed one and decompress it with the main cage base
the first 1MiB of the range is separately mapped kNoAccess as a null-dereference guard

failure_sink.description: if (!trusted_range_.InitReservation(kMaximalTrustedRangeSize)) calls V8::FatalProcessOutOfMemory(nullptr, "Failed to reserve virtual memory for TrustedRange") at isolate-group.cc:188-189. A reservation that succeeds at a base that is not 4GiB aligned dies earlier, at the release-mode CHECK(IsAligned(base_, params.base_alignment)) in src/utils/allocation.cc:363.

source_locations.symbol: comment: 'To achieve this, we simply require 4GB alignment of the allocation and assume that we can never map the zeroth page.'
comment: 'Certain (sandbox) bugs allow access to (only) the first 4GB of the address space, so we don't want sensitive objects to live there.'

extraction_limitations: two constraints here have no field: (a) the 4GiB alignment of a reservation with no fixed address, and (b) the lower bound 'base must be >= 2^32'. The schema's address-space reasoning is built around a single requested address and its containment in available ranges, not around bounds on an address the host is free to choose

V8 derives (b) from (a) plus 'the zeroth page is never mappable'. The profile does record min_map_address = 0x1000, which is exactly the fact that discharges that assumption on this host - but no rule connects an alignment to a minimum address, so the fact is never used

x_campaign.rationale: Same shape as the pointer-compression cage: required_alignment is unreachable without an address, so I expect the only finding to be RS-VM-0012 reserve/commit against posix_lazy, giving CONDITIONAL. Neither the alignment nor the 'must be above 2^32' bound will be evaluated.
